research_question: Why did short-horizon probabilistic forecast error remain high or temporally unstable: weak discrimination, calibration failure, covariate/target shift, state-dependent skill instability, estimation uncertainty, or insufficient expert-pool signal?

covariate_and_target_shift.feature_scope: Each parent's own frozen V1.63 input features, joined by origin_index to immutable v164_panel.csv

state_dependent_skill.interpretation: Exploratory failure attribution only; no state is promoted to a forecasting rule in V1.65-DIAG

oracle_headroom.interpretation: The per-origin oracle is unattainable retrospective upper-bound evidence only and never a deployable selector

failure_labels.ROBUST_BENCHMARK_SKILL: Frozen static parent beats frequency anchor with upper 95% block-bootstrap CI below zero excess Brier.
failure_labels.CALIBRATION_PROBLEM_PLAUSIBLE: AUC shows discrimination but proper-score skill is non-positive and ECE is material.
failure_labels.DISCRIMINATION_PROBLEM_PLAUSIBLE: AUC below frozen discrimination threshold while proper-score skill is non-positive.
failure_labels.COVARIATE_SHIFT_MATERIAL: Median or share of parent-input SMDs crosses frozen effect-size threshold.
failure_labels.TARGET_BASE_RATE_SHIFT_MATERIAL: Absolute UP-rate difference between 2025 and 2026 is at least 0.10.
failure_labels.STATE_DEPENDENT_INSTABILITY: At least 30% of comparable predeclared state strata flip the sign of Brier skill between 2025 and 2026.
failure_labels.ESTIMATION_UNCERTAINTY_MATERIAL: 95% block-bootstrap interval for excess Brier includes zero.
failure_labels.ORACLE_HEADROOM_MATERIAL: Unattainable per-origin oracle improves Brier over frequency by at least 0.02.

decision_lock.if_no_parent_has_robust_skill_and_oracle: Prioritize signal discovery and/or horizon redesign before detector, selector or stronger adaptation.
decision_lock.if_discrimination_exists_but_calibration: Test recalibration in a new frozen version before retraining the classifier.
decision_lock.if_covariate_shift_and_state_instability: Drift/adaptation research is eligible, but detector/adaptation parameters require a new pre-score contract.
decision_lock.if_oracle_headroom_is_material_and_state: State-dependent selection/gating research is eligible in a new frozen version.
decision_lock.if_uncertainty_is_material: Do not over-interpret point estimates; retain MORE_DATA_REQUIRED where appropriate.
